name: Render resolution 1280x720, output 1280x720
description: Output and render resolution 1280x720. Choose Performance in the game's graphics settings first. The first two writes are the display mode (the game's default output is 3840x2160); they are held: the game writes them again later and the patch follows. The game computes the render size from the display size and a table of scales of its upscaler quality modes (0.769, 0.667, 0.588, 0.5; Performance uses 0.667, so 854x480 at a 720p output). The last write sets that table to 1.0, so the game itself computes a 1280x720 render size (holding the render size instead, as the first version did, is a race: other game threads read it while it changes). Use only one variant.
author: batatinhafcbatatinha-pixel
tested: AnyPS5 (2026-11-18, new GPU engine, `tools/ps5port` with the file in the port's patches folder), RTX 3050 laptop GPU (8 GB), Ryzen 5 3600: display and render size 1280x720 (read in game memory), right picture, 59.6 fps in the bank scene of the prologue (the display's 60 Hz limit). KytyPS5 fork (2026-11-17, commits up to 2066efea, first version with the render size held): 59.8 fps in two 400 s runs; not yet run with the scale-table write.
